notes.title: Separate shared boards from personal chats
notes.description: Shared workspaces contain boards. Personal provider chats and local boards stay private. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.0 and 0.24.1.

notes.title: Edit ideas on a version roadmap
notes.description: Notes have status and priority; planned version columns do not create Git branches. Dragging highlights the destination. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.0.

notes.title: Read saved boards offline
notes.description: Previously fetched workspace catalogs and boards remain readable during a network outage. Offline editing is disabled. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.0.

notes.title: Open Rules and Changelog directly
notes.description: Separate document sections choose Git projects containing the relevant Markdown files. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.1.

notes.title: Route scanned QR codes to the correct connection
notes.description: PC pairing and workspace invitations follow separate flows; revoked pairing can be retried. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.1.

notes.title: Approve new workspace participants
notes.description: Independent invitations wait for host approval. Pending requests cannot read boards or files. Hosts can decline and revoke membership. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.2.

notes.title: Restore personal chats from cache
notes.description: Cached sessions restore before health/provider discovery. Failed job queries no longer block chat lists. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.2.

notes.title: Switch workspaces in the mobile header
notes.description: Keep the selected workspace across restarts and expose the participant count beside the selector. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.2.

notes.title: Use one host and a reusable display profile
notes.description: Consolidate legacy host-device profiles, preserve assignments, require first and last name, and allow self-renaming. Server migration and profile browser tests pass; release validation passed. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.3. Released in v0.25.3; see CHANGELOG.md for validation and remaining limitations.

notes.title: Support familiar desktop text shortcuts
notes.description: Ctrl+A selects a draft or the conversation; Ctrl+C copies selected text and Ctrl+V can focus the composer. Browser clipboard and native focus checks pass. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.3. Released in v0.25.3; see CHANGELOG.md for validation and remaining limitations.

notes.title: Delete boards and workspaces deliberately
notes.description: PC host confirms deletion. Workspace access and board metadata are removed; repository files remain. Generated board deletion persists. Server authorization and confirmation UI are covered. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.3. Released in v0.25.3; see CHANGELOG.md for validation and remaining limitations.

notes.title: Share portable board snapshots in Git
notes.description: Save and import ideas, feature descriptions, statuses, priorities, positions and dependency links. Exclude participant identities, assignments, chat links, credentials and machine paths. Snapshots do not commit or push automatically. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md, 0.25.3. Released in v0.25.3; see CHANGELOG.md for validation and remaining limitations.

notes.title: Validate the full workflow on physical Android
notes.description: Outstanding validation recorded in CHANGELOG.md. Check QR scanning, name reuse, approval, revocation, keyboard behavior, background reconnect and offline cache on a real device. Completion requires recorded device results; browser emulation is insufficient.

notes.title: Define isolated AI execution for shared members
notes.description: Shared members can collaborate on boards but cannot use the host personal AI account. Define account ownership, execution isolation, resource limits and review policy before implementing member-triggered runs. Recorded limitation: CHANGELOG.md, 0.24.1.

notes.title: AI board assistance and targeted notifications
notes.description:
CHANGELOG.md · 0.25.3
Built-in provider instructions help clarify ideas and maintain repository cards. The private host inbox notifies approved participants about assignments and concrete clarification requests. Acceptance: recipient isolation, replay deduplication and visible Windows/mobile inbox. Server checks and Windows browser inbox scenario passed. OS background push and physical Android verification remain follow-up; notifications currently refresh while the application is running. Released in v0.25.3; see CHANGELOG.md for validation and remaining limitations.

notes.title: Keep PC conversations separate and add neutral themes
notes.description:
CHANGELOG.md · 0.25.4
Personal chat state follows the PC connection and provider, independently of shared workspace selection. Neutral and provider-inspired light/dark palettes apply shared tokens and native Windows frame colors. Acceptance: two PCs with the same session ID preserve separate histories/drafts; all eight palette/mode combinations have readable contrast. Browser, build and artifact checks passed. Released in v0.25.4; physical Android verification remains pending.

notes.title: Browse repository boards and recover desktop chat interactions
notes.description: Problem: provider navigation, clipboard attachments and unavailable project folders interrupt normal work. Outcome: preserve Chats when changing providers, paste images with previews, read saved boards even when a folder is missing, and browse portable repository boards directly. Acceptance: clipboard image keeps the draft; repository list reads source files; missing folders preserve read-only data; unauthorized members cannot read other boards. Notification cards distinguish assignment and question details. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md 0.25.5; 31 browser scenarios, seven server/snapshot tests, builds, native Windows smoke, source/artifact privacy audits and GitHub CI passed; published v0.25.5 and verified its APK through the updater. Repository views currently read snapshots; shared editing remains in workspace boards. First workspace entry checks a password; later entries restore the same credential and profile. QR route, incorrect password, profile reuse and reload tested. See CHANGELOG.md for final release evidence.
